stops.title: Your overview
stops.caption: Every branch at once, and what needs you today.
stops.speech: This is the administrator view. Church Pulse counts every branch at once, and Needs You lists what is waiting on somebody today.

stops.title: Branches
stops.caption: Create them, group them by region, retire them.
stops.speech: Branches are yours alone. Only an administrator creates one, moves it between regions, or takes it out of active use.

stops.title: Inside a branch
stops.caption: Its details, and who currently leads it.
stops.speech: Open a branch to set its details and its leadership. Naming the main pastor here is what gives them sight of that branch's safeguarding queue.

stops.title: Regions
stops.caption: The geography your branches are grouped by.
stops.speech: Regions group branches by geography. Create the region first; a branch cannot be created until the region it belongs to exists.

stops.title: The approval queue
stops.caption: Nobody gets in until somebody lets them in.
stops.speech: Anyone who signs up themselves waits here. Approve them and they get full member access; reject them and the account is removed.

stops.title: Who holds what
stops.caption: Grants, not job titles, decide what people see.
stops.speech: Open a member to manage their grants. Kairos stores only two system roles, so everything else somebody can do comes from a grant.

stops.title: Membership classes
stops.caption: Church-wide, so no branch grant reaches it.
stops.speech: The membership programme is church-wide. Cohorts draw from every branch, so administering it takes a church-scoped grant, never a branch one.

stops.title: Reports across branches
stops.caption: The only view that compares one branch to another.
stops.speech: Reports are the cross-branch view. You are the only role that sees every branch side by side rather than one at a time.

stops.title: Your language
stops.caption: Kairos and this handbook, in four languages.
stops.speech: Kairos speaks English, French, Krio and Twi. Change it from the sidebar, and the handbook opens in the same language you chose.
